title: Uplifting Brine-Dried Slovakian Plums Compote
description: A nutty, springy, and refreshing Slovakian dish featuring a plum sauce made from brine-dried plums, perfect for serving in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the water, salt, brown sugar, black peppercorns, and ginger.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the salt and sugar have dissolved.
Add the plums to the saucepan and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Strain the liquid through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl, discarding the solids.
In a small bowl, whisk together the arrowroot powder and apple cider vinegar until smooth.
Add the arrowroot mixture to the plum liquid and stir to combine.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the compote thickens, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the coconut oil.
Transfer the compote to individual mini cocottes or ramekins.
Refrigerate the compote for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow it to set and thicken further.
